title: Your First HCL Block
scenario: HCL is built from blocks. A block has a type (here locals), no labels, and a body of arguments. Complete the locals block so the configuration records the application name.
constraints: Keep the surrounding file valid HCL.

focus.title: Complete the locals block
focus.todo: Add the application name argument inside the block.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Add the application name argument inside the block. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: app_name. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
